senses.gloss:
घोणस घोणस, अस्, m. = गो-नस, a kind of
serpent; (other authorities have घोनस.)

घोणा घोणा, f. (corrupted fr. घ्राणा ?),
the nose; the nose or nostrils of a horse.
घोणिन्, ई, m. a hog (as having a large snout).

घोण्टा घोण्टा, f. the jujube, Zizyphus
Jujuba, = वदर, वदरी; the betel-nut tree, see
गुवाक; a timber tree, Schrebera Sweietenoides.
—घोण्टा-फल, अस्, m. a kind of plant.
